The design utilizes additional memory to store delayed feedback values, enabling the filtering and subtraction operations performed synchronously with the clock.

  input signed [m-1:0] fb,

  input clk // Added clk as input

parameter m = 3; // number of feedback signals

reg signed [m-1:0] fb_delayed [0:n-1];
reg signed [m-1:0] fb_filtered [0:n-1];
